translateTo: Translate articles card action. $1 = language name in the interface language (e.g. "French").
viewsLabel: Trending card supporting line. $1 = compact view count, $2 = period ({{msg|common-viewsToday}} or {{msg|common-viewsOnDate}}).
machineTranslated: Label on content machine-translated by MinT from English Wikipedia.
allTab: Active discussions filter tab showing every noticeboard.
tryAgain: Retry button under a module that failed to load.
save: Accessible label of the bookmark button on an article card when the article is not saved yet.
savedState: Accessible label of the bookmark button on an article card when the article is already saved (state, not a command).
close: Accessible label of the close button of a full-screen page or dialog.
back: Accessible label of the back arrow in a mobile subpage header.
